hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/backend/*.py) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/backend" && uv run --quiet ruff format --quiet "$f" && uv run --quiet ruff check --fix --quiet --output-format concise "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
